description: Check an economy spec: refusals (each with a code, what it means and its fix) stop it from going live; warnings are what the person must hear (chance that pays money, revenue paid to stakers, an unfunded prize, a grant without limits, a mint’s powers). Run it after every change. Give the spec inline (`spec`), a file, or an example.

example.description: A worked example by name, from xsolana_examples (coin-flip-arena, stud-farm, …).

file.description: A JSON file holding the spec, relative to the project folder (default: xsolana.json when it exists).

spec.description: An economy spec (version 2) given inline. Takes precedence over file and example.

name: xsolana_check
